ctx.x: Yeah, okay. He was a great lead post.

Pop Smith I heard of a record he did with Fletcher Henderson around 1930 and he was hitting like a high up then. And you know Louie Armstrong was doing that like a clown act at the time. But had written into the arrangement. Pops was hitting it.
